title: The capabilities probe tells the SPA to show the GitHub Sponsors link by default

criteria.given: a default deployment with no -Dsaiku.sponsorLink / SAIKU_SPONSOR_LINK opt-out
criteria.then: GET /rest/saiku/info/capabilities reports sponsorLink: true, the flag the SPA reads before rendering the top-bar Sponsor link

steps.name: capabilities reports sponsorLink true on a default deployment

sponsorLink.because: the sponsor link is on unless the operator opts out
